But also, we don't have that much energy to play with and you can use it in very different places through the lap so let's wait and see just how exciting the first few laps are. It's gonna be pretty action packed."

items.title_zh: X 发帖 @oscarpiastri81：当我设定810美元的目标时，我试图选择一个我们认为在九月底前能够实际达到的数字。我有点犹豫是否设得这么高，因为知道我们很多人还在上学或处于职业生涯的早期阶段。我想给我们一个努力的方向，而不给任何人施加压力，让他们超出自己舒适范围地付出。但我真的...真的没想到，在不到24小时内，我们就筹集到了几乎三倍于目标的金额！😭💙 官方和额外筹款合计超过2400美元！我对每一个捐款、分享或帮助这个筹款活动触达更多人的人感激不尽。我想我永远不会停止对这个社区在决定为重要事情团结起来时所能取得的成就感到惊叹。我知道我一直说谢谢，但我真的不知道如何用语言表达我作为这样一个社区的一员是多么感激。我们的小🐝蜂巢是特别的。还要非常感谢来自更广泛的f1twt的每个人。我也看到很多人从这个社区的各个角落参与进来，看到我们为这样的原因团结在一起（即使我们很多时间都在这里争论赛车），我非常高兴。:) 我希望我们能在整个九月保持这种势头，并在未来围绕类似的倡议团结起来。👊 当然，排位赛日快乐！
items.summary: When I set our goal at $810, I tried to choose a number that felt realistic for us to reach by the end of September. I was a little hesitant about setting it even this high, knowing that so many of us are still in school/uni or in the early stages of our careers. I wanted to give us something to work towards without creating any pressure for anyone to give more than they comfortably could. But what I really… truly didn’t expect was that in less than 24 hours, we would raise ALMOST TRIPLE that amount! 😭💙 More than $2400 with the official and additional fundraiser combined! I am so incredibly grateful to every person who has donated, shared, or helped this fundraiser reach more people. I don't think I'll ever stop being amazed by what this community can accomplish when we decide to come together for something that matters. I know I keep saying thank you, but I genuinely don't know how else to put into words how grateful I am to be part of a community like this. Our little 🐝hive is a special one. And a huge thank you as well to everyone from the wider f1twt. I’ve also seen so many people participating from all corners of this community and it makes me so happy to see us all come together for causes like this (even if we spend a lot of our time here arguing about racing). :) I hppe we can keep this going throughout September and rally around similar initiatives in the future. 👊 And of course, happy quali day!
